slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the timing of purchases within a month. Its inventory balance constraint I_t = I_{t-1} + x_t - y_t silently assumes purchases are available before sales, without confirming the beginning-of-month purchase timing.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month and are available before that month's sales, as implied by the inventory balance I_t = I_{t-1} + x_t - y_t and the sales constraint y_t ≤ I_{t-1} + x_t.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked when purchases occur within the month, so the beginning-of-month timing was assumed rather than confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions about limits, objective, leftover inventory, integrality, and minimum stock, but it missed the P1 hidden slot on purchase timing and silently assumed beginning-of-month purchases in its final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
